name: Next Theme
author: Chyld Medford
description: Omarchy ships a long list of themes, and names like Miasma, Vantablack and Waffle Cat tell you nothing about how they look. Next Theme puts a contrast circle in your bar: click it for a popup with Previous and Next, or just scroll the icon. Every step applies the real theme to your whole desktop, and the popup stays open and re-colours itself as you browse, so you can walk the list and stop when it looks right.

barWidget.description: Step through your Omarchy themes one at a time, from the bar.
